reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and get most of this by copy-pasting into my tools. A LinkedIn ad saying 'AI co-workers' doesn't show me what it does on a Tuesday that my current subscription doesn't, so I'm not adding another 99 a month and another tool to learn.
objection: I don't have time to set up and learn another platform, and 100 credits a month sounds like it could run out fast without me knowing what a credit actually buys.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually running in my own CRM and inbox within an hour, with the onboarding team doing the setup, and a concrete example of hours saved per week compared with just using ChatGPT.
